rules: The winner is the overall men's/women's winner of the distance the race profile describes, not a longer or elite event (Matt, 2026-10-09).
Each field: keep if verified, correct if a sourced value exists, clear if unverifiable or about another year/distance. Prose is only trimmed to verified clauses.
PUBLISH = verified winner + at least one other verified rendered field; anything less = REDIRECT.

actions.clear: removed (unverifiable, wrong, or about another year/distance)
actions.trim: cut to a verbatim verified clause
actions.add: empty field set from a source
